# VideoTurko

> Patches, scripts and quality gates that run MiniMax H3 text-to-video (up to 209 frames, 8.7 s, 640x384, 24 fps) on a Windows 10/11 PC with a 4 GB NVIDIA GPU (tested: GTX 1050 Ti). The repository contains no model weights and no videos; `scripts/kur.ps1` downloads them from the official source after the user accepts the model license. Code is MIT; the model is not ours and has its own license.

Rules that never change: quality is fixed (6 steps, cfg 1, 24 fps, no tiled VAE, frame counts 17k+5); the model license is accepted by the human, never by an agent; exit codes 5 and 6 of `uret.ps1` mean the clip is not accepted; `init_image` is only a file path the user gave you; no personal paths, e-mail addresses or tokens in anything you write (use `<ROOT>`).

## Start here
- [tani.ps1](https://github.com/alexturkey/VideoTurko/blob/main/scripts/tani.ps1): run this first; read-only report (system, card, `kur.ps1 -Kuru`, deviations from the defaults); keep your progress in `DURUM.md` (git-ignored notebook in the root)
- [AGENTS_HIZLI.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/VideoTurko/blob/main/AGENTS_HIZLI.md): 12-step decision tree and exit code to action table (English and Turkish)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/VideoTurko/blob/main/AGENTS.md): full setup, hard rules, options, measurements and evidence labels
- [README.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/VideoTurko/blob/main/README.md): overview, license warning, quick start (29 translations; English is authoritative)

## When something fails
- [hata_imzalari.json](https://github.com/alexturkey/VideoTurko/blob/main/docs/hata_imzalari.json): stable error codes (`VT-E-*`, `VT-W-*`) with the first step in English and Turkish
- [SIK_HATALAR.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/VideoTurko/blob/main/docs/SIK_HATALAR.md): numbered common pitfalls with anchors per code
- [KURULUM.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/VideoTurko/blob/main/docs/KURULUM.md): building from source

## Safety, license, privacy
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/VideoTurko/blob/main/SECURITY.md): private reporting, what counts as a vulnerability, MCP threat model
- [LISANS_UYARISI.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/VideoTurko/blob/main/docs/LISANS_UYARISI.md): model license warning (territory limits apply to outputs)
- [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/VideoTurko/blob/main/PRIVACY.md): no telemetry; the only network addresses

## Optional
- [mcp/README.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/VideoTurko/blob/main/mcp/README.md): local stdio MCP server (`generate_video`, `job_status`, `cancel_job`); `VT_MCP_INIT_DIR` limits `init_image` to a folder
- [AGENTS_EK.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/VideoTurko/blob/main/docs/AGENTS_EK.md): details moved out of AGENTS.md (RTX 50 path, MCP server notes)
- [KAPILAR.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/VideoTurko/blob/main/docs/KAPILAR.md): quality gates and what they do not check
- [OLCUMLER.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/VideoTurko/blob/main/docs/OLCUMLER.md): measurements
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/alexturkey/VideoTurko/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): how to contribute
